subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should OpenClaw ship the restored full five-page Wear companion experience—including agent selection, paired-Phone Gateway controls, local theme, and automatic speech—as the supported Android release contract?
rationale: The patch is large and user-visible, changes the staged Phone/Watch compatibility contract, and carries release-scope implications that automated review cannot decide from tests and device proof alone.

options.title: Sponsor the full restored companion experience
options.body: Accept the complete Wear UX after rebasing to current main and rerunning final Android compatibility proof.

options.title: Narrow the release scope
options.body: Retain only the owner-approved companion controls and split any remaining UI or preference expansion into a separately sponsored PR.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full restored companion experience
recommendation.body: Accept the complete Wear UX after rebasing to current main and rerunning final Android compatibility proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline assigns this PR to steipete, who also authored the final protocol, session, and conversation-context hardening commits.
